quote: Erdős and Rado formally introduced the Van der Waerden function in 1951, establishing the notation and framework for computing exact values
note: Van der Waerden proved the existence of these numbers in 1927 (van der Waerden's theorem), but the computational problem of finding exact values W(r,k) was formally posed by Erdős and Rado in 1951-1952. Their foundational paper 'Combinatorial theorems on classifications of subsets of a given set' was published in Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society 3(2), pages 417-439 in 1952.
